purpose: Inventory other Indian cities with measurable coverage in current NCSCM coastal survey-plot services comparable to Mumbai; preserve evidence limits before source admission.

method.measurementSource: Retained count-only query outputs from NCSCM ArcGIS MapServer layers: 57 candidate names, approximate 1 km centre envelopes, approximate city bboxes, and selected 0.002-degree cell counts.
method.requestPacing: Original fetch helper enforced at least 1.1 seconds between uncached NCSCM requests. This artifact uses retained local results only.
method.countSemantics: ArcGIS returnCountOnly spatial intersects on WGS84 envelopes. Candidate city bboxes are researcher-defined approximations, not official boundaries.
method.sampleSelection: A quadtree-style count-only search selected a nearby dense 0.002-degree cell for cities with sparse centre cells; point, count, and distance are recorded.
method.sampleReview: At most 100 GeoJSON features were inspected in one 0.002-degree cell for selected representative cities/layers, checking fields, label tuple repetition/blanks, and pairwise polygon overlaps above 1 m². These are cell samples only.
method.cityIdentity: WUP/registry/app IDs were matched against the existing 223-city target set by exact display name or known WUP code; rows outside it retain supplied WUP codes where known, but registry/app identity is unverified.
method.vintage: Only metadata/path explicitly naming 2019 is called 2019. CZMP_STATES services without explicit vintage are unknown. Existing community report count comparisons to 2024 snapshots (about 2% match for live counts) do not establish publication vintage.

reachabilityAndCors.cors: Retained Origin-header probes for listed layer descriptors returned HTTP 200 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin reflecting https://urbangametheory.xyz, Vary: Origin, and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
reachabilityAndCors.reachability: Existing source survey reports queryable services returned HTTP 200 from laptop and check-host DE/US/SG nodes. India node had a broken-pipe result once; separate Tamil Nadu endpoint check returned 200 from India, DE, SG, and US. Do not infer geo-fencing from the transient failure.
reachabilityAndCors.limitations: Probe dates reflect 2026-10-13 and are not a live guarantee. No new network checks were made for this artifact.

communitySnapshotContext.purpose: Cross-reference for the ramSeraph/indian_cadastrals expansion path. These community-hosted vector tiles and release assets are distinct from direct NCSCM service access.
communitySnapshotContext.licenceAndTermsCaveat: The survey records CC0 release language with attribution requested, while noting the tile route is labelled not-so-open and upstream government reuse terms were unverified. Review terms before adoption.

limitationsAndFollowUp: This artifact assembles retained evidence; it is not a fresh end-to-end revalidation.
Older Maharashtra alternatives lack representative sample analysis.
Some 100-feature samples reached the transfer limit; sample uniqueness does not establish statewide stable identity.
The 4x4 coarse grid uses approximate bboxes; numeric counts are summarized among measured cells only and null cells remain unknown.
Use the recommendation batch as bounded admission work, then inspect exact target coverage, identity behavior, and source terms before adding catalog entries.
